description:
Save a reusable post snippet (opening/footer/CTA). Omit ``snippet_id`` to
create a new one; pass it to update an existing snippet in place (name/text/
favorite/doc). On update only the fields you pass change — omit ``favorite``
(leave it null) to keep it as-is, so a doc-only patch (e.g. toggling a snippet
dynamic) doesn't reset it. ``doc`` is the same block/flag document a post
carries, so the editor is identical for both. Free and owner-scoped. Returns
``{"success": true, "snippet": …}``.

doc.description: The block/flag document (same shape as a post's ``doc``), or null.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

favorite.description:
``true`` pins it as a one-click chiclet; null keeps the
current value on update (and means ``false`` on create).

name.description:
The snippet's label, up to 120 characters. Required on create;
blank on update keeps the current name.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

snippet_id.description: UUID of the snippet to update; blank creates a new one.

text.description:
The snippet body, up to 8000 characters. Required on create;
blank on update keeps the current body.

name: excalibur_save_snippet
title: Save a snippet
